name: DSFR Twig Components
description: Registers a Twig extension exposing DSFR (French State Design System) component functions plus HTML-markup and helper Twig functions, and an admin demo/reference page.
project_description: DSFR Twig Components registers a Twig extension that adds a family of Twig functions for building markup of the DSFR (Systeme de Design de l'Etat, the French State Design System) directly from templates. Functions prefixed dsfr_ (dsfr_alert, dsfr_card, dsfr_button, dsfr_title, ...) emit ready-made DSFR components; c_ / m_ helpers and a set of plain helpers (limit_string, convert_bytes, get_media_info, calc_image_ratio, uniq_id, ...) round out the toolkit. It is a building block for the DSFR module suite (DSFR Core and siblings depend on it) rather than something you configure: enable it and the functions become available in Twig. It ships an admin-only demo/reference page at /dsfr/twig/{slug} listing the available component functions, a Prism-based code library for the documentation, and an icon/pictogram catalog (Resources) that sibling modules use to generate JSON lists. Depends on core Media, Media Library and Text.
